goals.label: A week of posts
goals.template: Act as a social media strategist for a {niche}. Plan 7 days of Instagram posts aimed at {audience}. For each day, give me a hook, a caption under 120 words and 5 relevant hashtags. Keep the tone {tone}.

goals.label: Reply to a review
goals.template: I run a {niche}. Write a reply to a customer review that I'll paste below. Thank them by name, address their main point, and invite them back. Keep it {tone}, under 80 words, and written for {audience} who may read it later.

goals.label: Describe my offer
goals.template: Write a short description of my main offer as a {niche}. It's for {audience}. Lead with the problem it solves, list 3 concrete benefits, and end with a clear next step. Keep the tone {tone} and avoid buzzwords.
